| | |
| --- | --- |
| [Element](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mcs/chapters/sets.html#def-set) | $x \in A$ |
| [Empty set](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mcs/chapters/sets.html#def-empty-set), [cardinality](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mcs/chapters/sets.html#def-cardinality) | $\emptyset$, $\card{A}$ |
| [Subset](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mcs/chapters/sets.html#def-subset) | $A \subseteq B$: every element of $A$ is in $B$ |
| [Set equality](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mcs/chapters/set-proofs.html#thm-double-inclusion) | $A = B \Leftrightarrow A \subseteq B \land B \subseteq A$ |
| [Union](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mcs/chapters/sets.html#def-union) | $A \cup B = \set{x : x \in A \lor x \in B}$ |
| [Intersection](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mcs/chapters/sets.html#def-intersection) | $A \cap B = \set{x : x \in A \land x \in B}$ |
| [Difference](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mcs/chapters/sets.html#def-set-difference) | $A - B = \set{x : x \in A \land x \notin B}$ |
| [Power set](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mcs/chapters/sets.html#def-power-set) | $\powerset{A} = \set{S : S \subseteq A}$ |
| [Cartesian product](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mcs/chapters/sets.html#def-cartesian-product) | $A \times B = \set{(a, b) : a \in A \land b \in B}$ |

: Sets. {#tbl-ns-sets tbl-colwidths="[42,58]"}
